name: Nadia Penhallow
focus: Business returns, S corporations and partnerships
summary: Runs the firm and the business tax practice. Reviews and signs every business return before it goes out.
body:
Nadia joined Ada Tellmarsh's two-desk practice in 1998 and became a partner in 2006, when the firm took her name. She works mostly with owner-run companies of five to sixty people: contractors, restaurants and medical practices.

She reviews every business return the firm files. If you have a question about your return in March, the answer will come from her or from the person who prepared it, never from a call center.

name: Owen Tellmarsh
summary: Leads individual tax and year-round planning, from quarterly estimates to the year a client sells a business or retires.
body:
Owen is the founder's son and has prepared individual returns since 2004. He leads the planning practice: quarterly estimates, retirement distributions, equity compensation and the year someone sells a house, a practice or a farm.

He holds the Personal Financial Specialist credential (story) and runs the year-end planning meetings every November.

name: Marisol Ferreira
focus: IRS and state notices, payment plans
summary: An enrolled agent who answers IRS and state notices for clients. Send her the letter; she handles the reply.
body:
Marisol has represented clients before the IRS and the state revenue department since 2011. Most notices turn out to be a mismatch between a form the agency received and the return: she finds it, writes the reply and tracks it until it closes.

She also sets up payment plans when a balance cannot be paid at once.

name: Desmond Achterberg
summary: Works with forty local nonprofits: 990s, audit preparation, restricted funds and grant reports.
body: Desmond spent eight years as finance director of a regional food bank (story) before joining the firm. He prepares Forms 990 and 990-EZ, gets books ready for the annual audit, and sets up fund tracking that a volunteer treasurer can keep up.

name: June Okafor-Reyes
focus: Entity choice, budgets, buying and selling a business
summary: Helps owners with the decisions around the numbers: entity choice, budgets, loans and buying or selling a business.
body: June builds the cash-flow models and budgets behind loan applications and partner buyouts, and runs the firm's monthly advisory calls for clients on the monthly books plan.

name: Lena Hask
summary: Leads the bookkeeping team: monthly reconciliations, the five-day close and catch-up work for books that fell behind.
body: Lena's team keeps the books for about ninety small businesses. Each month closes on the fifth business day with a one-page summary and a list of anything that needs an answer from the owner.

name: Theo Barlowe
summary: Runs payroll for about sixty employers and the January rush of W-2s and 1099s.
body: Theo sets up payroll for first-time employers, files the quarterly payroll returns and gets W-2s and 1099s out by January 31. He is also the person to call when an employee's withholding looks wrong.
